name: scrooge-kit
description: Token-saving kit: routes terminal commands through rtk (60-90% output compression), teaches token hygiene, and bundles the Headroom & codebase-memory MCP servers. Bypass with SCROOGE_RAW=1; needs the rtk binary (brew install rtk) to take effect, and the headroom / codebase-memory-mcp binaries on PATH for the MCP servers.
